name: framecast
description: A recording studio in a browser tab, 100% local. Screen + draggable camera bubble, crash-safe direct-to-disk MP4, trim/convert/audio-enhance in the browser. Nothing leaves your machine.

paragraphs: A recording studio in a browser tab. 100% local.
Record your screen with a draggable, zoomable camera bubble, baked into the video as you move it. Crash-safe MP4 straight to disk. Trim, convert and clean up audio without uploading a single byte.
Try it live · Quick start · Features · How it stays local · Roadmap
features: Three layouts: screen + camera bubble, screen only, camera only

Scene framing, baked in live (no editor step): wrap the capture in a styled backdrop with padding, rounded corners and a soft shadow, with the camera bubble free to overlap the frame edge for the "breaking the border"…
